name: DENS Dacorum Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank covering Dacorum and Berkhamsted
description: DENS Dacorum Foodbank provides emergency food parcels. Berkhamsted collection point at The Way Inn Resource Centre open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm and Sat 9am-1pm.

name: Open Door Berkhamsted

description: Open Door runs community fridge launched November 2022 and a 24/7 community pantry. Cafe open Mon-Sat with warm space registration.
